d:
自从2022年后，山田一族基本上没有再更新光之美少女有关的作品了。最近我突然发现老师他把FANBOX上的所有2022年前的内容删除了。暂时不知是何故，我先把我现有的一些存下来的插图至这里，还有一些是漫画，担心和插图放在一个画廊会比较乱，可能另开一个画廊会合适一些。

Since 2022, yamada ichizoku has basically stopped updating any works related to Pretty Cure. Recently, I suddenly discovered that the teacher has deleted all content from before 2022 on FANBOX. I don't know the reason for now, so I'll first upload some of the illustrations I've saved here, along with some comics. I'm worried that putting them together with the illustrations in one gallery might be messy, so perhaps opening a separate gallery would be more suitable.
